weeks.note: Week 2: a snowy morning built from newly burned words, a valley town from enlightened ones, and a note from a friend for master and guru.

paragraphs.ja: {朝|あさ}、{外|そと}は{白|しろ}かったです。{雪|ゆき}です！{今年|ことし}はじめての{雪|ゆき}です。
paragraphs.en: In the morning it was white outside. Snow! The first snow of the year.

paragraphs.ja: {毎朝|まいあさ}、{近|ちか}くの{店|みせ}でコーヒーを{買|か}います。でも、{今日|きょう}は{雪|ゆき}が{多|おお}いです。{家|いえ}でお{茶|ちゃ}を{入|い}れました。
paragraphs.en: Every morning I buy coffee at a shop nearby. But today there's a lot of snow. I made tea at home.

paragraphs.ja: {朝|あさ}ごはんの{後|あと}、{弟|おとうと}に{手紙|てがみ}を{書|か}きました。{弟|おとうと}は{雪|ゆき}が{大好|だいす}きです。
paragraphs.en: After breakfast I wrote a letter to my younger brother. He loves snow.

paragraphs.ja: {午後|ごご}、{雪|ゆき}が{止|や}みました。{外|そと}に{出|で}て、{写真|しゃしん}を{撮|と}りました。{空|そら}が{本当|ほんとう}に{青|あお}かったです。
paragraphs.en: In the afternoon the snow stopped. I went out and took photos. The sky was really blue.

paragraphs.ja: {夜|よる}、{友人|ゆうじん}から{電話|でんわ}がありました。「{雪|ゆき}、すごいね！」「うん、やっぱり{冬|ふゆ}はいいね。」
paragraphs.en: At night a friend called. "The snow — amazing, right?" "Yeah, winter really is the best."

paragraphs.ja: {明日|あした}も{雪|ゆき}かな。じゃあ、{明日|あした}の{朝|あさ}も{家|いえ}でお{茶|ちゃ}です。
paragraphs.en: Snow tomorrow too, I wonder. Then tomorrow morning it's tea at home again.

questions.prompt: {毎朝|まいあさ}、どこでコーヒーを{買|か}いますか。
questions.en: Where does the writer buy coffee every morning?

options.why: 「{毎朝|まいあさ}、{近|ちか}くの{店|みせ}でコーヒーを{買|か}います」
Home is where the tea got made today, because of the snow. Coffee usually comes from the shop.
No station in this one. It's a shop nearby.

questions.prompt: {弟|おとうと}は{何|なに}が{大好|だいす}きですか。
questions.en: What does the younger brother love?

options.why: 「{弟|おとうと}は{雪|ゆき}が{大好|だいす}きです」: は is the brother (topic), が picks out what he loves.
The tea is the writer's, not the brother's.
The letter is what the writer sent him. Nothing says he loves letters.

questions.prompt: {午後|ごご}、{空|そら}はどうでしたか。
questions.en: How was the sky in the afternoon?

options.why: 「{空|そら}が{本当|ほんとう}に{青|あお}かったです」: once the snow stopped, the sky cleared.
White was the morning: 「{外|そと}は{白|しろ}かった」, the snow on the ground.
The snow stopped (止みました) in the afternoon.

questions.prompt: 「やっぱり{冬|ふゆ}はいいね」の「やっぱり」は、{何|なに}をしていますか。
questions.en: What is やっぱり doing in 「やっぱり冬はいいね」?

options.text: Confirming a feeling the friend already had
options.why: やっぱり = "just as I thought, after all." The snow confirms what they already believed about winter.
That's でも or だけど. やっぱり agrees with something, it doesn't turn against it.
That's ちょっと or 少し.

paragraphs.ja: {今日|きょう}は{谷|たに}の{小|ちい}さい{町|まち}に{来|き}ました。{天気|てんき}はいいです。{空|そら}が{明|あか}るいです。
paragraphs.en: Today I came to a small town in a valley. The weather's good. The sky is bright.

paragraphs.ja: {地図|ちず}を{見|み}ましたが、{道|みち}が{分|わ}かりません。{角|かど}に{交番|こうばん}がありました。
paragraphs.en: I looked at the map, but I couldn't work out the way. There was a police box on the corner.

paragraphs.ja: 「すみません、この{辺|へん}に{古|ふる}い{石|いし}の{橋|はし}がありますか。」「ありますよ。{池|いけ}の{近|ちか}くです。{歩|ある}いて{五分|ごふん}ぐらいです。」
paragraphs.en: "Excuse me, is there an old stone bridge around here?" "There is. It's near the pond. About five minutes on foot."

paragraphs.ja: 「{名所|めいしょ}ですか。」「はい、この{町|まち}で{一番|いちばん}の{名所|めいしょ}です。でも、{今|いま}の{時間|じかん}は{人|ひと}が{多|おお}いですよ。」
paragraphs.en: "Is it a famous spot?" "Yes, the most famous one in town. But at this time of day there are a lot of people."

paragraphs.ja: {橋|はし}の{下|した}に{川|かわ}がありました。{川|かわ}の{音|おと}は{音楽|おんがく}みたいでした。
paragraphs.en: There was a river under the bridge. The sound of the river was like music.

paragraphs.ja: {明日|あした}は{朝|あさ}{早|はや}く、{森|もり}の{道|みち}を{歩|ある}きます。{天気|てんき}は{大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}かな。
paragraphs.en: Tomorrow, early in the morning, I'll walk the forest path. I hope the weather holds.

questions.prompt: {交番|こうばん}はどこにありましたか。
questions.en: Where was the police box?

options.why: 「{角|かど}に{交番|こうばん}がありました」: に because it just exists there.
Near the pond is where the bridge is.
Under the bridge is the river.

questions.prompt: {橋|はし}まで、{歩|ある}いて{何分|なんぷん}ぐらいですか。
questions.en: About how many minutes to the bridge on foot?

options.why: 「{歩|ある}いて{五分|ごふん}ぐらいです」
Much less: it's close, near the pond.
The writer didn't know the way at first, but the officer gives the time: five minutes.

questions.prompt: {今|いま}の{時間|じかん}、{橋|はし}はどうですか。
questions.en: What's the bridge like at this time of day?

options.why: 「{今|いま}の{時間|じかん}は{人|ひと}が{多|おお}いですよ」: でも flags it as the catch.
少ない is the opposite of what the officer says.
The weather is good; the sky is bright.

questions.prompt: 「{音楽|おんがく}みたいでした」の「みたい」は、{何|なに}をしていますか。
questions.en: What is みたい doing in 「音楽みたいでした」?

options.why: Noun + みたい = "like ~, resembling ~." The river isn't music; it reminds the writer of it.
That's 〜たい (聞きたい). みたい after a noun compares.
That's 〜てみる. Similar sound, different job.

paragraphs.ja: {先日|せんじつ}はありがとう！{和食|わしょく}の{食事|しょくじ}、{楽|たの}しかったですね。
paragraphs.en: Thanks for the other day! That Japanese dinner was fun, wasn't it.

paragraphs.ja: {私|わたし}は{夕方|ゆうがた}まで{出|で}かけます。{部屋|へや}の{鍵|かぎ}はテーブルの{上|うえ}です。
paragraphs.en: I'm out until evening. The room key is on the table.

paragraphs.ja: {近|ちか}くに{魚屋|さかなや}と{茶屋|ちゃや}があります。{茶屋|ちゃや}のお{茶|ちゃ}は{本当|ほんとう}においしいですよ。
paragraphs.en: There's a fish shop and a tea house nearby. The tea at the tea house is really good.

paragraphs.ja: {夜|よる}は{星|ほし}がよく{見|み}えます。{和室|わしつ}の{後|うし}ろの{窓|まど}から、{海|うみ}も{見|み}えますよ。
paragraphs.en: At night you can see the stars well. From the window at the back of the tatami room, you can see the sea, too.

paragraphs.ja: {明日|あした}の{夜明|よあ}けに、{鳥|とり}の{声|こえ}を{録音|ろくおん}しませんか。いい{場所|ばしょ}があります。
paragraphs.en: Want to record the birds at dawn tomorrow? There's a good spot.

paragraphs.ja: {後|あと}で{私|わたし}の{絵|え}を{見|み}せますね。じゃあ、また{夕方|ゆうがた}に！
paragraphs.en: I'll show you my paintings later. OK, see you this evening!

questions.prompt: {友|とも}だちは{夕方|ゆうがた}まで{何|なに}をしますか。
questions.en: What is the friend doing until evening?

options.why: 「{夕方|ゆうがた}まで{出|で}かけます」: out of the house until evening.
The friend is out; only the key is in the room.

options.text: {鳥|とり}の{声|こえ}を{録音|ろくおん}します
options.why: That's the plan for tomorrow at dawn, not today.

questions.prompt: {和室|わしつ}の{後|うし}ろの{窓|まど}から、{何|なに}が{見|み}えますか。
questions.en: What can you see from the window at the back of the tatami room?

options.why: 「{後|うし}ろの{窓|まど}から、{海|うみ}も{見|み}えますよ」
The fish shop is nearby, but the note doesn't say you can see it.
The tea house is nearby too; the window shows the sea.

questions.prompt: 「{夜明|よあ}け」はいつですか。
questions.en: When is 夜明け?

options.text: {朝|あさ}、とても{早|はや}い{時間|じかん}
options.why: 夜明け is when the night (夜) opens up (明ける): dawn, the very start of the morning.
夕方 is evening, when the friend comes back.
夜 is part of the word, but 夜明け is the moment the night ends, not the night itself.

questions.prompt: {後|あと}で、{友|とも}だちは{何|なに}を{見|み}せますか。
questions.en: What will the friend show later?

options.why: 「{後|あと}で{私|わたし}の{絵|え}を{見|み}せますね」: 見せる = to show.
You can see the stars yourself at night (見えます); the friend isn't showing them.
The key is already on the table.

weeks.note: First batch: a rainy day off, a station in Kyushu, and a menu full of burned numbers.

paragraphs.ja: {今日|きょう}は{休日|きゅうじつ}です。でも、{朝|あさ}から{雨|あめ}です。{空|そら}は{白|しろ}いです。
paragraphs.en: Today is my day off. But it's been raining since morning. The sky is white.

paragraphs.ja: {朝|あさ}ごはんの{後|あと}で、コーヒーを{作|つく}りました。{犬|いぬ}はベッドの{下|した}で{休|やす}んでいます。
paragraphs.en: After breakfast I made coffee. The dog is resting under the bed.

paragraphs.ja: {午後|ごご}、{雨|あめ}が{少|すく}なくなりました。{犬|いぬ}と{町|まち}の{店|みせ}に{行|い}きました。
paragraphs.en: In the afternoon the rain let up. I went to a shop in town with the dog.

paragraphs.ja: {店|みせ}の{人|ひと}は「{今日|きょう}は{人|ひと}が{少|すく}ないですね」と{言|い}いました。
paragraphs.en: The shopkeeper said, "Not many people today, huh."

paragraphs.ja: {夜|よる}は{家|いえ}で{映画|えいが}を{見|み}ました。{長|なが}い{映画|えいが}でしたが、いい{映画|えいが}でした。
paragraphs.en: At night I watched a movie at home. It was a long movie, but a good one.

paragraphs.ja: {来週|らいしゅう}は{友人|ゆうじん}と{山|やま}に{行|い}きます。
paragraphs.en: Next week I'm going to the mountains with a friend.

questions.prompt: {朝|あさ}の{天気|てんき}はどうでしたか。
questions.en: What was the weather like in the morning?

options.why: 「{朝|あさ}から{雨|あめ}です」: it's been raining since the morning.

options.text: いい{天気|てんき}でした
options.why: The first paragraph says {朝|あさ}から{雨|あめ}です, so it wasn't nice out.

options.text: {空|そら}が{青|あお}かったです
options.why: 「{空|そら}は{白|しろ}いです」: the sky was white (overcast), not blue.

questions.prompt: {犬|いぬ}はどこで{休|やす}んでいましたか。
questions.en: Where was the dog resting?

options.why: 「ベッドの{下|した}で{休|やす}んでいます」: under the bed.
テーブルの{上|うえ} is "on the table." The passage says ベッドの{下|した}, under the bed.
The dog goes to the shop later, in the afternoon. In the morning it was at home under the bed.

questions.prompt: {店|みせ}の{人|ひと}は{何|なん}と{言|い}いましたか。
questions.en: What did the shopkeeper say?

options.why: 「{今日|きょう}は{人|ひと}が{少|すく}ないですね」: not many people today.
{多|おお}い is the opposite of {少|すく}ない. The rain kept people home.
{雨|あめ}が{少|すく}なくなりました is the narrator's line about the weather. The shopkeeper talks about people.

questions.prompt: {来週|らいしゅう}、{何|なに}をしますか。
questions.en: What's happening next week?

options.text: {友人|ゆうじん}と{山|やま}に{行|い}きます
options.why: 「{来週|らいしゅう}は{友人|ゆうじん}と{山|やま}に{行|い}きます」

options.text: {家|いえ}で{映画|えいが}を{見|み}ます
options.why: That was tonight ({夜|よる}), not next week.

options.text: {犬|いぬ}と{町|まち}に{行|い}きます
options.why: That was this afternoon ({午後|ごご}).

readings.title: {九州|きゅうしゅう}の{駅|えき}で

paragraphs.ja: {九州|きゅうしゅう}の{小|ちい}さい{駅|えき}で{電車|でんしゃ}を{下|お}りました。{西口|にしぐち}を{出|で}ると、{前|まえ}に{道|みち}が{一|ひと}つだけありました。
paragraphs.en: I got off the train at a small station in Kyushu. When I went out the west exit, there was just one road in front of me.

paragraphs.ja: {地図|ちず}を{見|み}ましたが、{店|みせ}の{場所|ばしょ}が{分|わ}かりません。タクシーもいません。
paragraphs.en: I looked at the map, but I couldn't work out where the restaurant was. There were no taxis, either.

paragraphs.ja: {駅|えき}の{近|ちか}くにいた{女|おんな}の{人|ひと}に、{住所|じゅうしょ}を{見|み}せました。
paragraphs.en: I showed the address to a woman who was near the station.

paragraphs.ja: 「ああ、この{店|みせ}は{有名|ゆうめい}ですよ。{和食|わしょく}の{店|みせ}です。{歩|ある}いて{十分|じゅっぷん}ぐらいです。」
paragraphs.en: "Oh, that place is famous. It's a Japanese restaurant. About ten minutes on foot."

paragraphs.ja: {私|わたし}は{東|ひがし}に{歩|ある}きました。{道|みち}は{長|なが}かったですが、{空気|くうき}がよかったです。
paragraphs.en: I walked east. The road was long, but the air was lovely.

paragraphs.ja: {店|みせ}の{人|ひと}はとても{元気|げんき}で、{和食|わしょく}は{本当|ほんとう}においしかったです。
paragraphs.en: The staff were really cheerful, and the food was truly delicious.

questions.prompt: どの{出口|でぐち}から{出|で}ましたか。
questions.en: Which exit did you leave by?

options.why: 「{西口|にしぐち}を{出|で}ると」: the west exit.
{東|ひがし} comes later: you walked east ({東|ひがし}に{歩|ある}きました) after leaving by the west exit.
{北口|きたぐち} is the north exit. The passage says {西口|にしぐち}.

questions.prompt: {店|みせ}まで{歩|ある}いてどのぐらいですか。
questions.en: How long a walk is it to the restaurant?

options.why: Here {十分|じゅっぷん} means "ten minutes." You know the same kanji from WaniKani as {十分|じゅうぶん}, "enough"; context decides which one it is.
She says about ten minutes. The road only felt long ({道|みち}は{長|なが}かった).
{十日|とおか} is ten days (or the 10th of the month), not ten minutes.

questions.prompt: どんな{店|みせ}ですか。
questions.en: What kind of place is it?

options.text: {有名|ゆうめい}な{和食|わしょく}の{店|みせ}
options.why: 「{有名|ゆうめい}ですよ。{和食|わしょく}の{店|みせ}です」: a famous Japanese restaurant.
A コンビニ never comes up. She calls it {和食|わしょく}の{店|みせ}.
It's about ten minutes' walk from the station, so it isn't inside it.

questions.prompt: {女|おんな}の{人|ひと}に{何|なに}を{見|み}せましたか。
questions.en: What did you show the woman?

options.why: 「{住所|じゅうしょ}を{見|み}せました」: the address.
You looked at the map yourself ({地図|ちず}を{見|み}ました), but you showed her the address.
Your name never comes up here.

paragraphs.ja: {生|なま}ビール……{五百円|ごひゃくえん}　／　お{茶|ちゃ}……{二百円|にひゃくえん}
paragraphs.en: Draft beer: 500 yen / Tea: 200 yen

paragraphs.ja: {牛肉|ぎゅうにく}と{玉|たま}ねぎ……{千円|せんえん}　／　{豚肉|ぶたにく}……{八百円|はっぴゃくえん}　／　{竹|たけ}の{子|こ}（{小皿|こざら}）……{三百円|さんびゃくえん}
paragraphs.en: Beef and onions: 1,000 yen / Pork: 800 yen / Bamboo shoots (small plate): 300 yen

paragraphs.ja: {店|みせ}の{人|ひと}：「{今日|きょう}は{牛肉|ぎゅうにく}が{人気|にんき}ですよ。」
paragraphs.en: Staff: "The beef is popular today."

paragraphs.ja: {私|わたし}：「じゃあ、{牛肉|ぎゅうにく}と{玉|たま}ねぎを{一|ひと}つと、{生|なま}ビールを{二|ふた}つ{下|くだ}さい。」
paragraphs.en: Me: "Then one beef and onions, and two draft beers, please."

paragraphs.ja: {店|みせ}の{人|ひと}：「はい。{竹|たけ}の{子|こ}もどうですか。{今|いま}が{一番|いちばん}おいしいですよ。」
paragraphs.en: Staff: "Sure. How about the bamboo shoots too? They're at their best right now."

paragraphs.ja: {私|わたし}：「じゃあ、それも{一|ひと}つお{願|ねが}いします。」
paragraphs.en: Me: "Then one of those too, please."

questions.prompt: {牛肉|ぎゅうにく}と{玉|たま}ねぎはいくらですか。
questions.en: How much is the beef and onions?

options.why: {千|せん} is a thousand: 1,000 yen.
{百|ひゃく} is a hundred. The menu says {千円|せんえん}.
{一万|いちまん} is ten thousand. That would be some beef.

questions.prompt: {生|なま}ビールをいくつ{注文|ちゅうもん}しましたか。
questions.en: How many draft beers did you order?

options.why: 「{生|なま}ビールを{二|ふた}つ{下|くだ}さい」: two.
{一|ひと}つ goes with the beef and onions. The beer is {二|ふた}つ.
Nobody says {三|みっ}つ. The order is {二|ふた}つ.

questions.prompt: {店|みせ}の{人|ひと}は、{何|なに}が{人気|にんき}だと{言|い}いましたか。
questions.en: What did the staff say was popular?

options.why: 「{今日|きょう}は{牛肉|ぎゅうにく}が{人気|にんき}ですよ」
{豚|ぶた} is pig, so {豚肉|ぶたにく} is pork. The popular dish is {牛肉|ぎゅうにく}, beef.
The staff recommends {竹|たけ}の{子|こ} next because it's in season ({今|いま}が{一番|いちばん}おいしい), but the popular dish is {牛肉|ぎゅうにく}.

questions.prompt: {全部|ぜんぶ}でいくらですか。
questions.en: What's the total?

options.text: {二千三百円|にせんさんびゃくえん}
options.why: Beef and onions 1,000 + two beers 500 × 2 + bamboo shoots 300 = 2,300 yen.

options.text: {千八百円|せんはっぴゃくえん}
options.why: That counts only one beer: 1,000 + 500 + 300. You ordered {二|ふた}つ.
That leaves out the {竹|たけ}の{子|こ} (300 yen) you added at the end.
